# golang — 2016 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 3 golang CVEs of 2016 are in `data/cve/vendors/golang/2016.jsonl`.

### CVE-2016-15005 — Cryptographically weak random number generation in github.com/dinever/golf
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE 338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

CSRF tokens are generated using math/rand, which is not a cryptographically secure random number generator, allowing an attacker to predict values and bypass CSRF protections with relatively few requests.

Affected:
- github.com/dinever/golf / github.com/dinever/golf: affected 0 <0.3.0 (semver)
